provenance.corrected_swap: ICON_MAP shipped `tablet` and `elder_thing` SWAPPED in the record. THIS FILE CARRIES THE CORRECTED PAIRING: elder_thing = U+F25E, tablet = U+F260. The swap was undetectable to every existing check -- typeset-cards.py:497's `miss_icons` preflight asserts INK, not identity, and tokenise/para_words/seg_advance/draw_layout are all value-transparent -- so a human `accepted` verdict on 2026-08-18 could not have caught it. That is why the (ink_fill, advance_em) pair below is DECLARED per token rather than merely measured at run time: the two glyphs differ measurably in both dimensions (tablet is a solid slab -- narrower advance, denser ink; elder_thing is a winged silhouette -- wider advance, sparser ink), and the anti-swap invariant is what turns that into a refusal.
provenance.occurrences_from: recounted over .am/midwinter-gala-korean/card-text-en.json; the unit is a distinct [icon] TOKEN, and `occurrences` is how many times that token appears across the 62 English cards. auto_fail and elder_sign are 0 on the cards and appear only in the campaign guide.
provenance.reference_pair: The recorded reference points reproduce exactly: U+F25E elder_thing 0.470 ink_fill / 0.916 advance_em, U+F260 tablet 0.659 / 0.826. Both re-measured from the font outlines by kz_checkers.measure_icon_metrics() at probe size 200 / advance size 32, not copied.
